title: Phone - Step 1 as opened
text: Same form, one column. Sales' details are already in; the customer can change them.

title: Phone - Step 1 with a joint applicant
text: Each applicant is a numbered block with its own Remove button; "+ Add another applicant" is at the bottom.

title: Phone - Step 2 Contact & address
text: Mobile and email pre-filled by Sales; address typed by the customer; Office address is a switch that opens its own fields.

title: Phone - Step 4 Unit details
text: Block, floor, flat, bedrooms, car park, area and price as agreed with Sales - changeable.

title: Phone - Step 5 Booking amount
text: Amount, date, reference and bank; the amount is also written in words.

title: Phone - Step 6 KYC documents
text: On a phone "Take a photo or attach a PDF" opens the camera. Up to 2 files per document.

title: Phone - Step 7 Terms & signature
text: On a phone, tapping the signature box opens a large signing pad.

title: Phone - the signing pad
text: A full-screen pad to sign with a finger. Done saves it into the signature box.
